subject: Use Jquery to do a alert in a table.

messages.author: cd24c23b205ce60b
messages.subject: Use Jquery to do a alert in a table.
parts:
I have a table with something, may be numbers and I want to see when click in a row show a alert, but I can do that, and I don't know why. I did the same with a static table and this work, but when the table is made with shiny don't work.
The server show me a table with the numbers but don't recognizes a event click.

The source is like this.

idex.html

<div id="table" class = "shiny-html-output">
</div>
<script type="text/javascript">
$("tr").click(function(){
alert("Hello World");
})
</script>

server.R

output$table <-renderTable(){
 a = matrix(0,nrow =10,ncol =10)
 return(a)
}

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Use Jquery to do a alert in a table.
parts:
Replace this line:


$("tr").click(function() {

With:

$(document).on("click", "tr", function(evt) {

The former is adding listeners to individual tr elements that exist at that moment. The latter adds listeners for, effectively, all current AND future tr elements. 
—
